subcompetencies.name: Technical Skills in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Consistently, safely, and efficiently performs neuraxial anesthesia with minimal complications in low-risk patients
Demonstrates advanced airway skills, including the management of a difficult airway
level_2: Consistently, safely, and efficiently performs general anesthesia with minimal complications in low-risk patients and identifies patients who need modification of plan for general anesthesia
Independently troubleshoots and manages problems or complications associated with neuraxial anesthesia
level_3: Troubleshoots and manages problems or complications associated with neuraxial anesthesia, with assistance (e.g., provides effective analgesia and anesthesia)
Consistently, safely, and efficiently performs general anesthesia with minimal complications in high-risk or complex patients, including airway management
level_4: Safely provides general anesthesia in emergent clinical situations
Serves as a consultant for initiation, management, and troubleshooting of technically challenging neuraxial anesthesia
level_5: Consistently, safely, and efficiently performs neuraxial anesthesia, including use of neuraxial ultrasound, in high-risk or complex patients and/or emergent situations
Serves as a consultant for management of complex general anesthetics of a pregnant patient

subcompetencies.name: Triage and Coordination of Obstetric Anesthesia Care

level_1: Identifies risk factors that may predispose patients to common medical or obstetric complications and develops a comprehensive anesthetic plan for patients requiring routine care
Directs resources to optimize care for multiple patients simultaneously
level_2: Defines clinically appropriate priorities when caring for multiple obstetric patients and identifies limited resources
Adapts the anesthetic plan to balance the ethical and other well- being considerations for the infant and the mother in complex clinical situations
level_3: Identifies risk factors that may predispose patients to complex or uncommon medical or obstetric complications and identifies the need for additional evaluation
Proactively advocates for and directs resources to optimize care for multiple patients with complex needs simultaneously
level_4: Coordinates and works cooperatively with other members of the obstetric anesthesia care team
Designs and implements multidisciplinary institutional protocols for efficient diagnosis and coordination of care for pregnant patients with specific high-risk conditions
level_5: Formulates and tailors anesthetic plans that include consideration of medical, obstetric, and anesthetic risk factors, as well as patient preference and available resources, for patients requiring complex care
Develops policies and procedures with the interprofessional team to address high patient workload and other institutional barriers to care

subcompetencies.name: Crisis Management for the Obstetric Patient

level_1: Participates as a member of the crisis response team; constructs appropriately prioritized differential diagnoses that include the most likely etiologies for common, acute clinical deterioration; and initiates appropriate therapy
Directs the management of major anesthetic complications
level_2: Recognizes and initiates treatment of common anesthetic complications and adverse events
Assumes leadership of a crisis response team
level_3: Participates as a member of the crisis response team; constructs appropriately prioritized differential diagnoses that include the most likely etiologies for uncommon, acute clinical deterioration; and initiates appropriate therapy
Organizes resources for interdisciplinary and interprofessional management of patient complications
level_4: Recognizes major anesthetic complications, and participates in the multi- disciplinary management team
Serves as a consultant in critical situations, and is a resource to others in the care team
level_5: Develops and executes a plan to manage uncommon clinical crises in a patient with complex comorbidities
Designs and implements institutional policies and protocols for the management of anesthetic complications and crises

subcompetencies.name: Antepartum Consultation, Assessment, and Peri-Anesthetic Care Planning

level_1: Performs an assessment and formulates a plan for pregnant patients, including common issues that impact obstetric anesthesia care

For complex consultations, delineates the clinical question, obtains additional clinical information, applies relevant resources, and recommends next steps with assistance; manages simple consultations independently
level_2: Describes the use of a consultation and lists useful resources
Advises the multidisciplinary team and integrates the anesthetic plans into the care of medically complex and critically ill obstetric patients
level_3: Performs an assessment and formulates an anesthetic plan for complex pregnant patients
Manages complex consultations independently, including addressing conflicting management goals with comprehensive, timely documentation of findings and recommendations
level_4: For simple consultations, delineates the clinical question, obtains additional clinical information, can access available resources, recommends next steps, and completes documentation, with assistance
Coordinates the multidisciplinary team involved in the care of medically complex and critically ill obstetric patients
level_5: Performs an assessment and formulates an anesthetic plan for critically ill pregnant patients
Is recognized as an expert in providing comprehensive consultations

subcompetencies.name: Point-of-Care Ultrasound for Obstetric Patients

level_1: Independently selects proper ultrasound equipment and settings for indicated scenarios and conducts and interprets point-of-care ultrasound
Uses point-of-care ultrasound to assess clinically complex situations
Expertly uses ultrasound for performance of truncal blocks in patients with complex anatomy
level_2: Identifies neuraxial anatomy on ultrasound
Uses ultrasound to identify interspinous spaces and the midline in patients with complex neuraxial anatomy
Participates in the development of institutional protocols for point-of-care ultrasound
level_3: Uses point-of-care ultrasound to identify common problems
Uses ultrasound for performance of truncal blocks in patients with complex anatomy
Promotes the use of neuraxial ultrasound for new and emerging indications
level_4: Uses ultrasound to identify interspinous spaces and the midline in patients with uncomplicated neuraxial anatomy
Expertly uses point-of- care ultrasound to diagnose and develop a management plan
level_5: Uses ultrasound for performance of truncal blocks in patients with uncomplicated anatomy
Expertly uses ultrasound to identify interspinous spaces and the midline in patients with complex neuraxial anatomy

subcompetencies.name: Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of the implications of altered maternal anatomy and physiology for the anesthetic care of healthy patients
Demonstrates knowledge of the evidence base that underpins obstetric management of common and complex conditions
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of obstetric management, including indications for delivery and expected complications, in healthy, low-risk patients
Integrates knowledge of maternal anatomy, physiology, and the obstetric management plan to develop an anesthetic management plan for a patient with coexisting disease and obstetric comorbidities
level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of the anesthetic implications of altered maternal anatomy and physiology for the care of patients with coexisting medical conditions (e.g., human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), cardiac disease, pulmonary hypertension)
Integrates knowledge of maternal anatomy, physiology, and the obstetric management plan to serve as a consultant in obstetric anesthesiology
level_4: Demonstrates knowledge of obstetric management, including indications for delivery and expected complications, in patients with complex comorbidities
level_5: Demonstrates knowledge of the evidence base that underpins anesthetic management of common and complex conditions

subcompetencies.name: Obstetrics and Neonatology Knowledge Applied to Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Demonstrates basic knowledge of normal newborn physiology
Demonstrates knowledge of measures of fetal well-being (e.g., biophysical profile)
Works collaboratively with the multidisciplinary team to prioritize anesthetic, obstetric, and neonatal considerations of the medically complex mother-fetal dyad
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of the impact of anesthesia on the mother and fetus
Demonstrates comprehensive knowledge of normal and abnormal newborn physiology
Incorporates data about fetal well-being in the development of an anesthetic plan
level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of basic fetal heart rate patterns
Integrates knowledge of the medically complex neonate into the development of the anesthetic plan
Exhibits detailed and up-to-date knowledge of current research in obstetrics and neonatology
level_4: Demonstrates basic knowledge of abnormal newborn physiology
Demonstrates knowledge of how fetal well-being data impacts delivery planning
Serves as a consultant for fetal surgery
level_5: Demonstrates knowledge of the medically complex neonate and how it impacts the anesthetic plan
Demonstrates knowledge of how newborn physiology impacts delivery planning
Serves as a consultant in the development of an anesthetic plan for fetal well-being

subcompetencies.name: Patient Safety and Quality Improvement in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of common events that impact patient safety
Describes departmental quality improvement initiatives
Discloses patient safety events to patients and patients’ families (simulated or actual)
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of how to report patient safety events
Participates in analysis of patient safety events (simulated or actual)
Demonstrates the skills required to identify, develop, implement, and analyze a quality improvement project
level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of basic quality improvement methodologies and metrics
Participates in disclosure of patient safety events to patients and patients’ families (simulated or actual)
Actively engages teams and processes to modify systems to prevent patient safety events
level_4: Identifies system factors that lead to patient safety events
Participates in department quality improvement initiatives
Acts as a role model or mentors others in the disclosure of patient safety events
level_5: Reports patient safety events through institutional reporting systems (simulated or actual)
Conducts analysis of patient safety events and offers error prevention strategies (simulated or actual)
Creates, implements, and assesses quality improvement initiatives at the institutional level or above

subcompetencies.name: System Navigation for Patient-Centered Care in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of care coordination
Identifies specific population and community health needs for their local population
Role models and advocates for safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs within and across health care delivery systems
level_2: Identifies and performs key elements for safe and effective transitions of care and hand-offs
Coordinates care of patients in complex clinical situations effectively using the roles of interprofessional team members
Participates in changing and adapting practice to provide for the needs of specific populations
level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of population and community health needs
Performs safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs in complex clinical situations
Analyzes the process of care coordination and participates in the design and implementation of improvements
level_4: Coordinates care of patients in routine clinical situations effectively using the roles of interprofessional team members
Uses institutional resources effectively to meet the needs of a patient population and community
Improves quality of transitions of care within and across health care delivery systems to optimize patient outcomes
level_5: Identifies and performs safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs in routine clinical situations
Role models effective coordination of patient-centered care among different disciplines and specialties
Advocates for populations and communities with specific health care needs in the peri- operative setting

subcompetencies.name: Physician Role in Health Care Systems in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Identifies key components of the complex health care system (e.g., hospital, finance, personnel, technology)
Explains the impact of documentation on billing and reimbursement
level_2: States factors impacting the costs of anesthetic care
Manages various components of the complex maternal health care system to provide efficient and effective patient care and transitions of care
level_3: Describes how components of a complex health care system are interrelated, and how they impact patient care
Practices and advocates for cost- effective maternal patient care
level_4: Documents anesthetic detail to facilitate accurate billing and reimbursement
Advocates for or leads systems change that enhances high-value, efficient, and effective maternal-fetal care
level_5: Discusses how individual practice affects the broader system (e.g., length of stay, readmission rates, clinical efficiency)
Engages in external activities related to advocacy for cost- effective maternal care

subcompetencies.name: Evidence-Based Practice and Scholarship in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Completes assigned/ recommended readings and reviews literature related to specific patient problems
Participates in scholarly activity related to the subspecialty
level_2: Participates in journal clubs, morbidity and mortality conferences, and other educational activities
Participates in development of evidence-based clinical protocols and guidelines
level_3: Critically evaluates the scientific literature and understands limitations in addressing clinical issues
Disseminates scholarly activity (e.g., abstract presentation, manuscript submission)
level_4: Uses self-directed literature review to modify patient care
Participates in editorial reviews and other scholarly activity for peer-reviewed medical journals
level_5: Independently integrates evidence- based practices into clinical care
Participates in and leads professional society and other activities to advance scholarship

subcompetencies.name: Reflective Practice and Commitment to Personal Growth in Obstetric

level_1: Accepts responsibility for personal and professional development by establishing goals
Designs and implements a learning plan, with prompting
Considers alternatives to improve performance
level_2: Identifies the factors that contribute to performance deficits
Seeks performance data episodically, with adaptability and humility
Integrates performance data to adapt the learning plan
level_3: Actively seeks opportunities to improve
Institutes behavioral change(s) to improve performance
Role models consistently seeking performance data with adaptability and humility
level_4: Demonstrates openness to performance data (feedback and other input) to inform goals
Independently creates and implements a learning plan
Models reflective practice
level_5: Analyzes and acknowledges the factors that contribute to performance deficits
Intentionally seeks performance data consistently, with adaptability and humility
Facilitates the design and implementation of learning plans for others

subcompetencies.name: Mentorship and Teaching in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Demonstrates self- awareness and identifies gaps in knowledge, skills, and experience; incorporates feedback
level_2: Teaches medical students, residents, and patients in informal settings; seeks faculty mentorship for self
level_3: Teaches health professionals in formal settings (e.g., nursing in-service training, residency teaching conference); mentors medical students
level_4: Organizes educational activities at the program level; mentors residents and other health care professionals
level_5: Designs and implements clinical rotations, curricula, or learning and assessment tools; models and teaches mentoring to others

subcompetencies.name: Professional Behavior and Ethical Principles in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Identifies potential triggers for professionalism lapses
Analyzes straightforward situations using ethical principles
Actively solicits help and acts on recommendations to resolve complex interpersonal situations
level_2: Describes when and how to report lapses in professionalism
Demonstrates professional behavior in complex or stressful situations
Recognizes and uses resources for managing and resolving ethical dilemmas
level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of the ethical principles underlying patient care
Recognizes need to seek help in managing and resolving complex interpersonal situations
Coaches others when their behavior fails to meet professional expectations
level_4: Demonstrates insight into professional behavior in routine situations
Analyzes complex situations using ethical principles
Identifies and seeks to address system-level factors that induce or exacerbate ethical problems or impede their resolution
level_5: Takes responsibility for one’s own professionalism lapses
Recognizes situations that may trigger professionalism lapses and intervenes to prevent lapses in oneself

subcompetencies.name: Accountability/Conscientiousness in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Responds promptly to requests or reminders to complete tasks
Takes responsibility for tasks not completed in a timely manner and identifies strategies to prevent recurrence
level_2: Takes responsibility for failure to complete tasks
Prioritizes tasks and responsibilities in a timely manner with appropriate attention to detail in complex or stressful situations
level_3: Performs tasks and responsibilities in a timely manner
Proactively implements strategies to ensure that the needs of patients, teams, and systems are met
level_4: Recognizes situations that may impact one’s own ability to complete tasks and responsibilities in a timely manner
Designs and implements an institutional systems approach to ensure timely task completion and shared responsibility
level_5: Performs tasks and responsibilities in a timely manner with appropriate attention to detail in routine situations

subcompetencies.name: Well-Being in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Recognizes the importance of addressing personal and professional well- being
Independently develops a plan to promote personal and professional well- being
level_2: Lists available resources for personal and professional well- being
Describes institutional factors that positively and/or negatively affect well-being
level_3: Describes institutional resources that are meant to promote well- being
Creates institutional- level interventions that promote colleagues’ well-being
level_4: With assistance, proposes a plan to promote personal and professional well-being
Describes institutional programs designed to examine systemic contributors to burnout
level_5: Recognizes which institutional factors affect well-being

subcompetencies.name: Patient- and Family-Centered Communication in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Communicates with patients and their families in an understandable and respectful manner
Uses shared decision- making to make a personalized care plan
level_2: Provides timely updates to patients and patients’ families
Facilitates difficult discussions with patients and patients’ families
level_3: Customizes communication in the setting of biases and barriers with patients and patients’ families
Effectively negotiates and manages conflict among patients, patients’ families, and the health care team
level_4: Actively listens to patients and patients’ families to elicit patient preferences and expectations
Mentors others in the facilitation of crucial conversations
level_5: Explains complex and difficult information to patients and patients’ families
Mentors others in conflict resolution

subcompetencies.name: Patient Counseling in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Demonstrates understanding of the informed consent process
level_2: Answers questions about treatment plans and seeks guidance when appropriate
level_3: Counsels patients through the decision- making process, including answering questions, for simple clinical problems
level_4: Counsels patients through the decision- making process, including answering questions, for complex clinical problems
level_5: Counsels patients through the decision- making process, including answering questions, for uncommon clinical problems

subcompetencies.name: Interprofessional and Team Communication in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Respectfully requests or receives consultations
Solicits feedback on performance as a member of the health care team
Maintains effective communication in crisis situations
level_2: Uses language that values all members of the health care team
Uses closed-loop communication to verify understanding
Communicates constructive feedback to superiors
level_3: Respectfully receives feedback from the health care team
Adapts communication style to fit team needs
Role models flexible communication strategies that value input from all health care team members, resolving conflict when needed
level_4: Clearly, concisely, and promptly requests or responds to a request for consultation
Communicates concerns and provides feedback to peers and learners
Leads an after-event debrief of the health care team
level_5: Communicates information effectively with all health care team members
Coordinates recommendations from different members of the health care team to optimize patient care
Facilitates regular health care team-based feedback in complex situations

subcompetencies.name: Communication within Health Care Systems in Obstetric Anesthesiology

level_1: Accurately records information in the patient record; demonstrates judicious use of documentation shortcuts
Respectfully communicates concerns about the system
Models exemplary written or verbal communication
level_2: Safeguards patients’ personal health information
Accurately records information in the anesthetic record and communicates complex care decisions for complex cases
Uses appropriate channels to offer clear and constructive suggestions to improve the system
level_3: Communicates through appropriate channels as required by institutional policy
Appropriately selects direct and indirect forms of communication based on context
Explores innovative uses of the medical record to facilitate peri- operative management
level_4: Accurately records information in the anesthetic record for non-complex cases
Respectfully communicates concerns about the system and contributes to solutions
Guides departmental or institutional policies and procedures around communication
level_5: Documents required data in formats specified by institutional policy
Uses medical record functionality to highlight challenges in anesthetic care to facilitate future peri- operative management
Initiates difficult conversations with appropriate stakeholders to improve the system
